active_laws: LAW: Every new funnel run must go through the canonical funnel first, and its results must feed back through that canonical funnel before it can push or claim working results. (symbiotic)
LAW: Every build change must increment its Blueprint revision.
LAW: No stage may certify itself.
LAW: Runtime evidence outranks comments and source plausibility.
LAW: Exact user language outranks summaries.
LAW: One-off scripts must be deleted after use.
LAW: Never claim real-iPhone behavior without Sebastian's eyes.
LAW: Test the exact owner-visible path before claiming success.
LAW: Render Queue pushes require HEAD check, surgical edits, post-propagation byte verification.

bad_box.description: Accumulated failures. Check before trying something new.
bad_box.expectation: Each entry: timestamp, what_failed, why, do_not (anti-pattern), context.
patterns: Do not accept unverified receipts as authority
Do not assume null/empty/massive inputs are handled
Do not trust single-source results without cross-reference
Do not embed full Page 0 text

data_expectations._honesty_note: Marked CURRENT (exists now) vs PLANNED (does not exist yet).

embeddings.expectation: Vector representations. Must include model ID and version.

evolution_logs.expectation: Append-only. Each entry: timestamp, test ID, pass/fail, pattern classification.

processed_data.expectation: Derived from raw. Must reference source hash. Reproducible.

raw_dogfood.expectation: Immutable input logs. Content-addressed by SHA-256. Never mutated.

stable_paths.expectation: Absolute paths only. No relative drift. Mount stable across reboots.

versioning.expectation: Git commits for code. Append-only JSONL for logs. Blueprint revisions increment on every change.

expedition_wiring.competition: updateCompetitiveScore() on every seat (+quality, -unresolved). getCompetitiveRanking(). No elimination until final tournament.
expedition_wiring.distillers: seedIntentDistillers() detects 6 Page 0 signals, weights capped min(count/10,3).
expedition_wiring.evidence_pool: shareEvidence() content-addressed by SHA-256. Pre-work pool check before investigating.
expedition_wiring.gen2: runChildInvestigation() — parent-determined focus. NOT canonical funnel runs (known limitation).
invariants: Page 0 by reference (hash only, never full text)
expedition_wiring.page0_by_reference: getPage0()/getPage0Ref() — lazy text, ~100-byte hash ref. Saves ~2.5MB per 256-seat run.
expedition_wiring.tournament: runMatchFunnel() — quality-weighted, position-independent, ties labeled arbitrary.

forward_observer_constraints.blocking: Non-blocking. Wrong predictions = wasted compute, not wrong results.
forward_observer_constraints.status: Partially implemented (predictForwardErrors). Full Forward Observer as code NOT yet built.
forward_observer_constraints.stopping_rule: Stop when guessing begins. Say 'I don't know.'

foundry_state.3d_map: Live 3D map of funnel system exists (tagline: 'geometry is the document, lines are relationships').
foundry_state.blueprint: Foundry blueprint exists — plan to turn the 3D map into a workshop.
foundry_state.note: Sebastian: 'It changes the whole operating system.'
foundry_state.status: Blueprint exists. Workshop not built. 3D editing was explicit non-goal of fabric v1.

good_box.description: Verified reusable machinery. Use before inventing.
good_box.expectation: Each capability: id, provides[], verification evidence, reuse count.

M1_immutable_evaluation.what: Deep-frozen contract. Later success cannot redefine success.

M2_composition_first.what: What percentage already exists in composable form?

M3_failure_capitalization.what: Failure to signature to detector to fixture to test to pattern.

M4_bidirectional_replay.what: Backward protects intent. Forward protects consequences.

M8_authority_creativity.what: Narrow authority, safe basin for creativity.

authority_rules: Share information aggressively. Share authority reluctantly.
page0.core_law: NO CLAIM MAY HAVE HIGHER STATUS THAN STRONGEST INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE.
page0.foundational_inversion: The model stopped being the authority that decides what the user meant.

recursive_grammar.description: 7 locked stages. Pre/post conditions each. Receipt only if all valid.

solver_society.proposed: Funnels that wait on each other, spawn diagnostic funnels, affect each other non-linearly.

ssd_design_constraints.2_content_addressed: Raw data addressed by hash, not filename alone.
ssd_design_constraints.3_append_only: Evolution logs and anti-intent are append-only JSONL.
ssd_design_constraints.4_label_planned: Separate CURRENT from PLANNED trees. Do not mix without labeling.
ssd_design_constraints.6_data_not_authority: SSD data does not grant authority. Only kernel receipts do.
ssd_design_constraints.7_good_bad_boxes: Good Box = verified capabilities. Bad Box = anti-intent log. Both need stable paths.
